hero.headline: Intelligence you can assert.
hero.subheadline: ASSERT designs, builds and deploys AI systems for organisations where decisions carry weight: defense, energy, the legal sector and private enterprise. Secure by design, built to work in Greece and across Europe.

intro.title: AI that works in real operations
intro.text:
ASSERT is a Greek AI company that turns complex, sensitive data into decisions people can act on. We work with defense organisations, energy operators, law firms and businesses to put artificial intelligence into real operations, not just pilots.

Every system we deliver is explainable, auditable and built to meet European regulation from day one.

sectorsIntro: We bring AI to sectors where accuracy, security and accountability are not optional.
productsIntro: Proven platforms, ready to deploy and tailored to your organisation.
